rank_background: all 978 measured landmarks; query/randomization pool limited to 948 human-mapped landmarks
direction_rule: Connectivity=(ES_up-ES_down)/2; set to zero if ES_up*ES_down>=0. Reversal=-Connectivity; positive means reversal.
aggregation: median across signatures within compound-cell, then median across cells
null_scheme: joint without-replacement permutation of up/down labels within human all-sample mean-expression and SD strata; preserves both set counts and disjointness
p_value: one-sided (1+null>=observed)/(B+1); nonpositive reversal receives P=1; BH over all 482 eligible multicell compounds
bootstrap_scheme: resample human biological samples with replacement within each of four groups; recompute limma/eBayes/BH across all genes; select landmark up/down top100 by abs(t); minimum15 each; report failed coverage replicates
supported_candidate_gate: primary empirical BH q<0.05, positive score, >=50% cell medians positive, top20 inclusion >=0.5 across all planned bootstrap replicates, positive reversal for both size sensitivities and both preprocessing/sample sensitivities
phase1_status: not yet acquired; no cross-release robustness claims
scope: competitive random-gene-set evidence plus human sampling stability; no clinical efficacy or causal claims
